name: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo
positioning: Luxury hotel in the Piantini District of downtown Santo Domingo, with an outdoor infinity pool, a rooftop bar with glass flooring and contemporary rooms with city views
best_for: Travelers who want a modern downtown base in Santo Domingo's Piantini District
Guests who want city views, an infinity pool and rooftop cocktails

facts.text: The hotel is in the Piantini District of downtown Santo Domingo.
The hotel is near the Colonial Zone, Catedral Primada de America and Alcazar de Colon.
The hotel has an outdoor infinity pool.
Rooms have contemporary design and city views.
Rooms have large windows that bring in plenty of natural light.
Bathrooms are marble, with large bathtubs and rain showers.
Executive suites come with exclusive lounge access and free breakfast.
Vertygo 101 Lounge & Bar has glass flooring and a rooftop area with an outdoor terrace.
Winston's Grill & Patio serves international cuisine prepared with modern flair and has a full bar.
The hotel has nine event venues with catering services and AV equipment.
The hotel is The Green Key Certified.

considerations.text: Las Americas International Airport is about 33 km from the hotel.
The fitness center for hotel guests is at BlueMall.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack beachfront access.
